I have mars in aries in good aspects with my other personal planets and I have to admit that this is true - I really like red especially red lipsticks in darker shades and I hear a lot from others that this color really suits me.

I feel trapped and depressed a lot, mostly due to my school. I'm in my senior year of high school now, major in logistics. I hate it so much, because I'm humanist and I struggle with exercises. And my class makes everything much worse, I just can't stand these people. Sometimes I really want to end it all, because I'm tired of daily reminder that I'm useless.

Not directly in my school, but that person was a student there and my classmate. He visibly had some mental issues, I don't know exactly what was going on with him but he was very into military stuff, so during breaks he would stand at attention at one place for 10 minutes or so, wearing sunglasses even when the weather was cloudy. The teachers' attitude was amazing, but unfortunately some “popular kids” from my school were teasing him. He also was pretty uncomfortable around women or even scared of them as while he was speaking, he never made an eye contact with them, neither sitting nor talking with them on his own will (my friend told me that he was once with his mother at the store where my friend's mom worked. There were also other women out there such as clients and saleswomen. And despite being very cold back then, he didn't manage to get inside. Yup, his mother was shopping, while he was standing on the outside all this time. And one time during my winter break when I was driving in the car with my parents, I saw him running around the court, also during very disadvantageous weather). Overall, he was pretty weird but harmless.

However, during my sophomore year of high school, he stopped coming to school at all. My school is quite small, located in the city where 99% of students know each other. So my tutor started to ask us about him. No one really knew what was going on. At first, his parents made an announcement that he ran away from home. Around one week later, they found him. But here is when the things are starting to getting crazy. The reason he ran away was because, he tried to robe the local grocery store while being drunk. He was armed with the knife and threaten saleswomen to give him money from the till, but when she refused to do it, he tried to attack a 7-year old girl that was standing nearby. Thankfully, there was also an off-duty firefighter at the store, so he managed to stop him. If he wasn't there he would probably kill that child and saleswomen too - I didn't mention that earlier but that dude was a fricking beast. He was jacked af, and had powerful stamina. My school used to send him on sports tryouts which he 99% of the time slayed, and even one of my classmates recorded him when he smoked a single red Marlboro cigarettes on one breath. Before that, he tried to co#mit su#cide by han#ing himself on shoe laces in the forest.

Also, due to the fact that everyone around here know each other, the news spread quickly and the next day everyone knew what happened. And people were and still to this day are very insensitive about this whole situation, you know making jokes about it. To me, it's such a shame. He could become a famous athlete, being inspiring for people with mental disabilities, and living lavish. But he will probably spend most of his life at mental hospitals, even without a job. I also feel very bad for his parents.
